reason: Type error/notation collision: in the registered def-routef-raw-factor-setting governing this workspace, I_B explicitly denotes the identity map B->B. But pi(D) lies in B, and def-fd-cstar-diagonal requires pi(D) to equal the unit element 1_B (the source writes I_calB), not an identity map. Thus the asserted equation pi(D)=I_B is ill-typed in the target context, even though lem-kitaev-diagonal-repair itself validly supplies pi(D)=1_B. Replace I_B here by the algebra unit (for example 1_B, or unqualified I with the adjacent element type) before this application is well-formed.
